name: mostra
description: Communicate visually with the people you work for: write a React page, verify it, publish it behind a private link and get their answers back.

interface.shortDescription: Communicate visually with the people you work for: write a React page, verify it, publish it behind a private link and get their answers back.
interface.longDescription: Mostra is the agent artifact runtime. Your agent writes an ordinary React page (questions, a choice between options, a plan to approve, a report, a dashboard), checks it in a headless browser, and publishes it on your machine behind a private link. People answer in the page; their answers are saved as they type and come back to the agent as results.
defaultPrompt: Ask me these questions as a Mostra page and wait for my answers.
Show me the three designs side by side in Mostra so I can pick one.
